House of Piranesi Atelier Locations --> Login Cart Collections Products View all products Butterfly Jewelry in Gold: Luxury Rings, Earrings & Necklaces Butterfly jewelry captures a sense of transformation, beauty, and movement, making it one of the most enduring motifs in luxury design. When paired with bold gemstones and sculptural gold settings, butterfly jewelry becomes more than symbolic, it becomes a statement of artistry and individuality. At Piranesi, butterfly jewelry is reimagined through vibrant gemstones like turquoise, malachite, and lapis lazuli, set in rich gold designs that feel both modern and timeless. Each piece reflects a balance between delicate inspiration and bold execution. The Meaning Behind Butterfly Jewelry Butterflies have long symbolized transformation, renewal, and freedom. In jewelry, this symbolism translates into pieces that feel expressive and deeply personal. Common meanings associated with butterfly jewelry: Transformation and growth Beauty and elegance Freedom and individuality New beginnings These meanings make butterfly jewelry a meaningful choice for both everyday wear and special occasions. Butterfly Rings: Bold Meets Delicate Butterfly rings combine intricate design with bold presence. When crafted in gold and set with gemstones, they become striking statement pieces. Popular butterfly ring styles: Gemstone butterfly rings – featuring turquoise, malachite, or lapis lazuli Gold butterfly rings – sculptural and refined Statement butterfly rings – bold, eye-catching designs Designer butterfly rings – artistic, one-of-a-kind pieces These rings are perfect for those who want jewelry that is both symbolic and visually impactful. Butterfly Earrings: Movement and Elegance Butterfly earrings bring a sense of movement and lightness to any look. Whether subtle or bold, they frame the face beautifully. Types of butterfly earrings: Butterfly stud earrings Drop earrings with gemstone butterflies Statement butterfly earrings Gold butterfly earrings Gemstones add depth and color, enhancing the visual appeal of the butterfly motif. Butterfly Necklaces & Pendants Butterfly necklaces are elegant and expressive, often serving as the focal point of a jewelry look. Popular styles: Butterfly pendant necklaces Statement butterfly necklaces Gemstone butterfly pendants Gold chain necklaces with butterfly motifs A butterfly pendant in gold offers both sophistication and symbolic meaning. Butterfly Jewelry as Statement Jewelry Butterfly designs naturally lend themselves to statement jewelry , especially when paired with bold gemstones. Why butterfly jewelry stands out: Recognizable and meaningful motif Works well with large, colorful gemstones Combines delicacy with bold design Appeals to both classic and modern tastes A turquoise butterfly ring or malachite pendant can instantly become the centerpiece of an outfit. Gemstones in Butterfly Jewelry At Piranesi, butterfly jewelry is elevated through the use of vibrant gemstones. Common gemstone pairings: Turquoise – bright and energetic Malachite – rich and sophisticated Lapis lazuli – deep blue with timeless appeal Opal – soft, luminous color These stones bring life and dimension to butterfly designs. Gold Butterfly Jewelry: Timeless Luxury Gold provides the perfect foundation for butterfly jewelry. Benefits of gold settings: Enhances gemstone color Adds warmth and richness Ensures durability Creates a luxurious finish Gold butterfly jewelry feels both timeless and contemporary, making it suitable for any collection. How to Style Butterfly Jewelry Butterfly jewelry is versatile and easy to style. Styling tips: Pair with neutral outfits to highlight the design Wear a single statement piece for maximum impact Combine with other gold jewelry for cohesion Choose gemstone colors that complement your look Butterfly jewelry can be worn casually or dressed up for special occasions. Butterfly Jewelry for Every Occasion Butterfly jewelry transitions effortlessly between settings: Everyday wear Evening events Celebrations and milestones Professional environments Its symbolic meaning also makes it a thoughtful gift. Luxury Butterfly Jewelry vs. Mass Market Luxury butterfly jewelry stands apart through design and craftsmanship. Key differences: Higher-quality materials More intricate detailing Unique, artistic designs Greater durability and finish Mass-produced pieces often lack the depth and individuality of luxury designs. Explore Butterfly Jewelry at Piranesi Piranesi’s butterfly jewelry blends symbolism, artistry, and bold design. Explore pieces including: Butterfly statement rings Gold butterfly earrings Butterfly pendant necklaces Gemstone butterfly designs Each piece is crafted to capture both beauty and meaning. Why Choose Piranesi Butterfly Jewelry Italian-inspired craftsmanship Unique, artistic designs High-quality gemstones Bold yet refined aesthetic Piranesi creates butterfly jewelry that is expressive, luxurious, and timeless. FAQ SECTION What does butterfly jewelry symbolize? Butterfly jewelry symbolizes transformation, growth, and freedom. Is butterfly jewelry in style? Yes, butterfly motifs remain popular in both fine and fashion jewelry. What gemstones are used in butterfly jewelry? Common gemstones include turquoise, malachite, lapis lazuli, and opal. Can butterfly jewelry be worn every day? Yes, many designs are versatile enough for everyday wear. Canadian Privacy Rights (PIPEDA & Quebec Law 25) If you are located in Canada, you may have rights regarding your personal information under the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and, in Quebec, Law 25. Please use the options below to exercise your rights. Access or download my data You can request access to the personal information we hold about you, including account details and order history. Where applicable (for example, under Quebec's Law 25), you may also request a copy of your computerized personal information in a portable format. Request Data Report Enter your email to confirm your identity Response time: We will respond within 30 days (or as otherwise permitted by applicable law). Correct my information If you believe the personal information we hold about you is inaccurate or incomplete, you can request a correction. Edit Personal Info Enter your email to confirm your identity Delete my data You can request deletion of personal information associated with your account. Request Deletion Enter your email to confirm your identity Important: This request is subject to certain exceptions. For example, we may retain information where required for legal, security, or tax reporting purposes. Your privacy choice Manage Your Privacy Choices Depending on your location, you may have the right to opt out of the sale of your personal info, withdraw consent for tracking, or customize your cookie preferences. Update Privacy Settings Privacy contact If you have questions about your privacy rights, please contact: Email: nadine@piranesi.com Address: 592 5th Avenue, Fifth Floor, 10036 New York New York, United States Complaints If you believe your privacy rights have been violated, you may file a complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC) or, in Quebec, the Commission d'accès à l'information (CAI). all products The House of Piranesi The Multi-Generational Italian House of Piranesi has been at the forefront of couture high jewelry for over a century. An Italian gem nestled in the heart of New York, is a beacon of exquisite artistry and opulence. With a legacy steeped in Old World charm and a commitment to unparalleled craftsmanship, Piranesi crafts fine jewelry that transcends time. Each piece is a symphony of rare and precious gemstones to captivating design, resonating with the soul of Italy and the pulse of New York. From rare diamonds to vibrant sapphires, Piranesi's creations blend the allure of the Old World with the vibrancy of contemporary aesthetics, delivering timeless luxury from generation to generation. " style=" object-fit:cover;object-position:50.0% 50.0%; " > MILAN Piranesi, established in Milan, cultivated its vision for artistry and the influence of the Italian culture to further elevate the already prestigious and sophisticated brand. At its core, Piranesi values excellent quality and fine craftsmanship as the key to its success. " style=" object-fit:cover;object-position:50.0% 50.0%; " > NEW YORK In 1976, Piranesi began its journey in New York City at the world-famous landmark, Rockefeller Plaza, after having moved its headquarters from Milan. Today, the House of Piranesi has made its new home on Fifth Avenue. Piranesi is recognized as one of the most well respected and trusted brands in the fine jewelry arena. Piranesi partners with the top retailers in the country as well as Europe and South America. " style=" object-fit:cover;object-position:50.0% 50.0%; " > ASPEN Piranesi of Aspen first opened its doors in 1993, serving as its only storefront presence. Situated amongst the peaks and valleys of the monumental Aspen Mountains, Piranesi is Aspen’s top luxury destination. " class="image-with-text__image" style=" object-fit:cover;object-position:50.0% 50.0%; " > FROM GENERATION TO GENERATION Abraham's great-grandson, Sami, carried on the family heritage of traditional excellence and craftsmanship using the world's most precious gems and metals. Sami's extensive experience throughout his exotic travels across the world had brought him a unique understanding of rough stones, diamond mines, cutting stones, pearls, estate, and vintage jewelry. And most of all, a sophisticated taste for excellence. As the company evolves from generation to generation, it is now carried on by Sami’s wife and children. Piranesi continues to be a leader brand and has carved a niche in the jewelry world. It has developed the boutique collection, alongside the masterpiece and couture collection, enabling the brand to deliver the Piranesi experience to a wider audience worldwide, with a dominant presence in the finest stores in the country. Correct my information If you believe the personal information we maintain about you is inaccurate, you can request a correction here. --> Login Cart Collections Products View all products Opal Jewelry in Gold: Rings, Earrings & Luminous Statement Designs Opal jewelry is unlike any other. It is defined by its luminous color play and ever-changing iridescence. From soft pink opals to vibrant multicolored stones, opal jewelry offers a unique visual experience that shifts with light and movement. At Piranesi, opal is transformed into bold, sculptural designs set in rich gold. Whether featured in statement rings, elegant earrings, or refined necklaces, opal jewelry blends softness with striking presence, making it a standout choice in luxury gemstone collections. What Is Opal? Opal is a gemstone known for its internal play-of-color, where flashes of different hues appear as the stone moves. Key characteristics: Iridescent color play Soft, luminous appearance Wide range of colors (white, pink, multicolor) Unique patterns in every stone Unlike traditional gemstones, opal offers a dynamic visual effect that makes each piece truly one-of-a-kind. Opal Rings: Luminous Statement Pieces Opal rings are among the most captivating forms of gemstone jewelry. Their shifting colors create a sense of movement and depth. Popular styles: Opal statement rings – bold designs with large stones Pink opal rings – soft, feminine tones Gold opal rings – warm settings enhance luminosity Designer opal rings – artistic and unique These rings are ideal for those seeking something expressive and distinctive. Opal Earrings: Subtle Yet Striking Opal earrings offer a refined way to wear this unique gemstone. Their subtle color shifts add elegance without overwhelming a look. Types of opal earrings: Drop earrings with opal accents Pink opal stud earrings Statement opal earrings Designer opal earrings These earrings are versatile and suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. Opal Necklaces & Pendants An opal necklace adds a luminous focal point to any outfit. Its shifting colors create visual interest and depth. Popular styles: Opal pendant necklaces Statement opal necklaces Pink opal necklaces Gold chain necklaces with opal Opal pendants are especially popular for their ability to blend softness with sophistication. Featured Pink Opal Pendant Designs For collectors seeking feminine color and refined craftsmanship, our pink opal pendant designs offer a fresh take on luxury gemstone jewelry. The Capri Flower Necklace showcases luminous pink opal set in an elegant floral silhouette, creating a statement piece that transitions effortlessly from day to evening. Discover this exceptional design as part of our signature opal collection. Why Opal Is a Unique Gemstone Opal stands apart from other gemstones due to its internal structure, which creates its signature play-of-color. What makes opal special: Dynamic color changes Soft yet vibrant appearance Unique patterns in every stone Works in both bold and delicate designs No two opals are ever exactly alike. Pink Opal Jewelry: Soft and Elegant Pink opal offers a more subtle take on opal jewelry, with gentle tones that feel refined and modern. Why choose pink opal: Soft, feminine color Elegant and understated Pairs beautifully with gold Ideal for both everyday and formal wear Pink opal jewelry is perfect for those who prefer a more delicate aesthetic. Opal and Gold: A Luminous Pairing Gold enhances the natural beauty of opal, creating a warm and luxurious contrast. Benefits: Highlights opal’s color play Adds richness and depth Creates a timeless look This pairing is a hallmark of high-end opal jewelry. Opal Jewelry as Statement Jewelry While opal can be subtle, it also works beautifully in statement designs. Why opal works for statement jewelry: Unique visual movement Larger stones amplify color play Combines softness with bold design An opal statement ring or necklace offers a different kind of impact — one that is dynamic and refined. How to Style Opal Jewelry Styling tips: Pair with neutral tones to highlight color shifts Combine with gold jewelry for cohesion Let one opal piece be the focal point Avoid mixing with too many bold gemstones Opal jewelry works well for both minimalist and statement looks. Luxury Opal Jewelry vs. Mass Market Luxury opal jewelry offers a higher level of quality and design. Key differences: Better color play and clarity Higher-quality gold settings Unique, artistic designs Greater durability Mass-produced pieces often lack the depth and refinement of luxury designs. Explore Opal Jewelry at Piranesi Piranesi’s opal jewelry combines bold design with exceptional craftsmanship. Explore pieces including: Opal statement rings Pink opal earrings Opal pendant necklaces Designer gemstone creations Each piece is crafted to highlight the unique beauty of opal. Why Choose Piranesi Opal Jewelry Italian-inspired artistry Premium opal gemstones Unique, statement-driven designs Timeless yet modern appeal Piranesi creates opal jewelry that is both expressive and refined. FAQ SECTION What is opal jewelry? Opal jewelry features gemstones known for their iridescent color play. Is opal a luxury gemstone? Yes. especially when used in high-quality designs with gold. Diamond Rings Black diamond rings offer a bold, elegant alternative to traditional diamond jewelry. With their deep, dramatic color and unmistakable sophistication, black diamonds create a striking contrast against 18K gold, white diamonds, and colorful gemstone accents. At Piranesi, black diamond rings are designed for women who appreciate fine jewelry with presence, artistry, and individuality. Whether chosen as a statement ring, cocktail ring, fashion ring, or symbolic piece of fine jewelry, a black diamond ring captures attention without relying on excess. The beauty of black diamonds lies in their mystery, contrast, and versatility. They can feel modern, romantic, architectural, or dramatic depending on the design, making them one of the most distinctive choices in luxury jewelry. Piranesi’s approach to black diamond rings reflects the house’s passion for refined craftsmanship, rich materials, and Italian-inspired design. From sculptural gold settings to floral motifs and diamond-accented compositions, each ring is created to feel timeless while still making a powerful contemporary statement. Explore Black Diamond Rings by Piranesi A black diamond ring is more than a piece of jewelry. It is a personal expression of confidence, style, and sophistication. Unlike traditional white diamond rings, black diamond rings have a darker, more dramatic look that feels distinctive and fashion-forward. Their bold appearance makes them especially appealing for collectors who want jewelry that stands apart from more conventional designs. Piranesi black diamond rings are ideal for women seeking fine jewelry that can transition beautifully from day to evening. A black diamond ring can be worn as a signature everyday piece, a dramatic evening accessory, or a luxurious complement to other diamond and gemstone jewelry. When paired with polished 18K gold, black diamonds offer warmth and contrast. When paired with white diamonds, they create a striking black-and-white composition that feels elegant and refined. For shoppers looking for a distinctive luxury ring, black diamonds provide a compelling alternative to classic gemstone choices. Their visual strength makes them ideal for bold silhouettes, floral-inspired designs, dome rings, and cocktail rings. Piranesi’s designs highlight the depth and brilliance of black diamonds while preserving the elegance expected from fine jewelry. 18K Gold Black Diamond Rings One of the most luxurious ways to wear black diamonds is in an 18K gold setting. Gold enhances the richness of black diamonds and gives each ring a warm, polished appearance. Whether the design features yellow gold, white gold, or rose gold, the contrast between precious metal and dark diamond creates a sophisticated look that is both timeless and modern. An 18K gold black diamond ring is a strong choice for anyone seeking fine jewelry with lasting value and visual impact. The gold setting provides durability and elegance, while the black diamonds create a sense of depth and individuality. This combination is especially effective in statement rings, where the bold tone of the stones can be balanced by the softness and luster of the gold. Piranesi’s black diamond designs often reflect a sculptural sensibility. The rings are not simply built around gemstones; they are composed as works of wearable art. The balance between metal, stone, shape, and proportion allows each piece to feel luxurious without appearing overly ornate. For shoppers specifically searching for black diamond rings , an 18K gold design offers one of the most refined options. It combines the mystery of black diamonds with the enduring prestige of fine gold jewelry. Statement Black Diamond Cocktail Rings Black diamond cocktail rings are designed to be noticed. With their dramatic color and strong visual contrast, black diamonds are especially well suited to larger, more expressive ring designs. A cocktail ring featuring black diamonds can instantly elevate an outfit, making it an ideal choice for formal events, evening wear, and special occasions. The beauty of a black diamond cocktail ring is that it feels bold without sacrificing elegance. While some gemstones rely on bright color to attract attention, black diamonds create impact through depth, shadow, and contrast. This gives the jewelry a sophisticated edge that works beautifully with both classic and contemporary fashion. Piranesi’s black diamond rings may feature floral, dome, or sculptural influences that make each design distinctive. A black diamond ring can be worn alone as a focal point or styled with diamond bracelets, gold earrings, or a refined necklace to create a complete luxury jewelry look. Black Diamond Dome Ring with 9.61 carats Black Diamonds in 18K White and Black Gold Designer Black Diamond Rings for Women Designer black diamond rings for women are perfect for those who want jewelry with character. These rings offer an alternative to traditional diamond jewelry while still preserving the elegance, craftsmanship, and luxury associated with fine diamonds. A black diamond ring can feel romantic, dramatic, modern, or artistic depending on the setting and design. Black Diamond Small Dome Ring with 2.80 carats Black Diamonds in 18K Rose and Black Gold Piranesi’s jewelry is known for its refined details and expressive collections. Rather than creating ordinary gemstone rings, Piranesi designs pieces with personality and presence. A black diamond ring from Piranesi can serve as a signature piece—one that reflects the wearer’s confidence and appreciation for distinctive design. Black diamond rings are especially appealing because they pair beautifully with many styles. They can be worn with minimalist clothing for a sharp, modern contrast or paired with luxurious fabrics and eveningwear for a more dramatic effect. Their dark tone also makes them highly versatile, coordinating easily with gold, white diamonds, black attire, jewel tones, and neutral palettes. For women who already own classic diamond jewelry, a black diamond ring adds variety and depth to a fine jewelry collection. It introduces a different mood while remaining elegant enough for long-term wear. Black and White Diamond Ring Designs One of the most elegant combinations in fine jewelry is black diamonds paired with white diamonds. The contrast between the two creates a refined visual balance: black diamonds provide depth and drama, while white diamonds add brightness and brilliance. Together, they create a sophisticated design language that feels both classic and unexpected. Black Diamond Double Flower Ring with 2.25 carats of Black and White Diamonds in 18K Rose Gold Black and white diamond rings are ideal for shoppers who want a piece that feels luxurious but not predictable. The contrast can emphasize floral shapes, geometric forms, or sculptural details. It can also make the ring more versatile, allowing it to coordinate with both white diamond jewelry and darker, more dramatic accessories. A black and white diamond ring can work beautifully as a cocktail ring, anniversary gift, special occasion piece, or personal luxury purchase. Unlike more traditional diamond rings, the black-and-white palette feels distinctive and expressive, making it especially appealing to collectors who appreciate design as much as materials. Piranesi’s use of contrast, gemstone composition, and fine craftsmanship makes black and white diamond ring designs a natural fit for the brand’s luxury aesthetic. Black Diamond Rings as Statement Jewelry A black diamond ring is one of the most powerful forms of statement jewelry. Its color gives it immediate visual presence, while its association with diamonds maintains a sense of luxury and refinement. For shoppers seeking something different from traditional diamond jewelry, black diamonds offer the perfect balance of sophistication and individuality. Statement rings are often chosen because they express personality. A black diamond ring can communicate confidence, elegance, creativity, and strength. It is a piece that does not disappear into an outfit. Instead, it becomes part of the wearer’s personal style. Piranesi black diamond rings are especially suited for collectors who value jewelry with artistic influence. These rings can be styled with other Piranesi collections or worn independently as a defining accessory. Whether the design is floral, rounded, dimensional, or architectural, the black diamonds give the ring a memorable sense of drama. How to Style a Black Diamond Ring Black diamond rings are surprisingly versatile. Their dark tone allows them to pair easily with many wardrobe colors and jewelry styles. For an elegant evening look, a black diamond cocktail ring can be worn with a black dress, silk blouse, or tailored suit. The result is refined, dramatic, and polished. For daytime wear, a smaller black diamond ring can add sophistication to a simple outfit. It can be styled with gold bracelets, diamond studs, gemstone earrings, or layered necklaces. Because black diamonds are neutral in color, they do not clash with most gemstones or metals. A black diamond ring also works beautifully when paired with other diamond jewelry. White diamonds add brightness, while black diamonds add depth. This makes black diamond jewelry ideal for creating contrast within a fine jewelry collection. Shoppers interested in a coordinated look may also explore Piranesi’s broader jewelry collections, including rings , earrings , bracelets , and necklaces . Why Choose a Black Diamond Ring? Black diamond rings are chosen by people who want something distinctive. While white diamonds are classic and luminous, black diamonds are bold, mysterious, and modern. They offer a different kind of beauty—one defined by contrast, depth, and individuality. There are several reasons shoppers choose black diamond rings: They offer a dramatic alternative to traditional diamond rings. They pair beautifully with 18K gold and white diamonds. They work well as statement rings and cocktail rings. They feel luxurious, modern, and distinctive. They can be worn for both formal occasions and everyday elegance. For those who appreciate jewelry with personality, a black diamond ring is an exceptional choice. It stands out while remaining sophisticated, making it one of the most compelling options in luxury fine jewelry. Piranesi Black Diamond Jewelry Craftsmanship Piranesi’s fine jewelry reflects a commitment to artistry, material quality, and elegant design. Every ring is created with attention to proportion, detail, and wearability. Black diamonds require thoughtful design because their visual impact is strong. The setting, metal choice, and surrounding gemstones must all work together to enhance the beauty of the stones. In Piranesi’s black diamond rings, the gemstones are not treated as decoration alone. They are central to the character of the piece. The dark brilliance of the diamonds gives each ring a distinctive identity, while the craftsmanship ensures that the design remains refined and luxurious. Whether you are searching for a black diamond statement ring, a black and white diamond ring, or a designer black diamond ring in 18K gold, Piranesi offers pieces that balance boldness with elegance. Shop Black Diamond Rings at Piranesi If you are looking for a black diamond ring that feels luxurious, distinctive, and beautifully crafted, Piranesi offers designs that go beyond the ordinary. These rings are created for those who appreciate jewelry with depth, contrast, and artistic character. Explore Piranesi’s selection of luxury rings and discover black diamond designs that reflect sophistication, individuality, and timeless beauty. From dramatic cocktail rings to refined 18K gold creations, a Piranesi black diamond ring is a striking addition to any fine jewelry collection. Frequently Asked Questions About Black Diamond Rings What is a black diamond ring? A black diamond ring is a fine jewelry ring that features black diamonds as the primary gemstone or as part of the design. Black diamonds are known for their dark, dramatic appearance and are often used in statement rings, cocktail rings, and modern luxury jewelry. Are black diamond rings popular? Yes. Black diamond rings have become increasingly popular among shoppers looking for distinctive alternatives to traditional white diamond jewelry. Their bold appearance makes them especially appealing for statement jewelry and designer rings. Can black diamond rings be worn every day? Many black diamond rings can be worn regularly, depending on the setting and design. As with all fine jewelry, it is best to avoid harsh impact, chemicals, and abrasive surfaces to preserve the beauty of the ring. What metals look best with black diamonds? Black diamonds pair beautifully with 18K yellow gold, white gold, and rose gold. Yellow gold creates warmth and contrast, white gold emphasizes a sleek modern look, and rose gold adds softness and elegance. Are black diamond rings good for special occasions? Black diamond rings are excellent for special occasions because they are bold, elegant, and memorable. They are often chosen as cocktail rings, anniversary gifts, evening jewelry, or personal luxury pieces. What should I wear with a black diamond ring? A black diamond ring can be styled with gold jewelry, white diamond pieces, gemstone earrings, bracelets, or necklaces. Its neutral dark tone makes it versatile enough to pair with both formal and everyday looks. --> Login Cart Collections Products View all products Lapis Lazuli Jewelry: Blue Gemstone Rings, Earrings & Necklaces Lapis lazuli jewelry is defined by its deep, celestial blue color and natural flecks of gold-like pyrite, creating a look that is both bold and timeless. Revered for thousands of years, lapis lazuli remains one of the most distinctive gemstones in luxury jewelry, offering richness, depth, and unmistakable character. At Piranesi, lapis lazuli is transformed into sculptural gold designs that highlight the stone’s natural beauty. Whether in statement rings, elegant earrings, or refined necklaces, lapis lazuli jewelry offers a striking balance of tradition and modern design. Luxury Lapis Lazuli Jewelry Piranesi’s collection of lapis lazuli jewelry combines rich blue gemstones with radiant gold, diamonds, and artistic craftsmanship. Whether you are searching for a dramatic cocktail ring, elegant earrings, or a signature necklace, lapis lazuli offers a vibrant alternative to traditional gemstones. Every design reflects the bold sophistication and timeless luxury that define Piranesi. Our one-of-a-kind pieces are created for collectors, style lovers, and those who appreciate rare gemstone jewelry with unmistakable character. What Is Lapis Lazuli? Lapis lazuli is a natural metamorphic stone prized for its intense royal blue color and subtle flecks of pyrite that resemble stars in the night sky. Because each gemstone forms naturally, every piece of lapis lazuli jewelry is unique. Key characteristics: Rich deep blue color Natural gold-like pyrite inclusions Smooth polished finish Strong visual presence Timeless luxury appeal Each stone is unique, making every piece of lapis lazuli jewelry one-of-a-kind. Lapis Lazuli Rings: Bold Blue Statements A lapis lazuli ring is one of the most striking ways to wear this gemstone. The vivid blue color naturally draws attention and pairs beautifully with yellow gold. Popular styles: Lapis statement rings: large stones with strong presence Cocktail rings: elegant, bold designs Gold lapis lazuli rings: warm contrast enhances the blue Designer lapis rings: artistic, one-of-a-kind pieces Piranesi lapis lazuli rings are ideal for day or evening wear and bring confidence, individuality, and elegance to any jewelry collection. Lapis Lazuli Earrings: Refined and Striking Lapis lazuli earrings offer a refined way to wear bold color. The gemstone’s deep blue tone enhances the face and pairs effortlessly with diamonds or polished gold. Types of lapis earrings: Drop earrings with lapis stones Lapis stud earrings in gold Statement earrings featuring large stones Designer lapis lazuli earrings These earrings are versatile and suitable for both day and evening wear. Lapis Lazuli Necklaces & Pendants A lapis lazuli necklace creates an unforgettable focal point. Its rich blue color contrasts beautifully with gold settings, creating jewelry that feels both timeless and modern. Popular styles: Lapis pendant necklaces Statement lapis necklaces Beaded gemstone necklaces Gold chain necklaces with lapis accents The deep blue color pairs beautifully with gold, creating a timeless aesthetic. The Power of Blue Gemstone Jewelry Blue gemstones symbolize calm, confidence, depth, and sophistication. Among them, lapis lazuli remains one of the most recognizable and luxurious choices. Universally flattering color Pairs with warm and cool tones Bold yet refined appearance Distinctive without overpowering For clients seeking statement jewelry with timeless elegance, lapis lazuli is unmatched. Lapis Lazuli and Gold: A Timeless Combination The pairing of lapis lazuli with gold has been admired for centuries. Yellow gold enhances the richness of the blue gemstone, while white gold offers a sleek modern contrast. Luxurious color contrast Warmth and richness Classic fine jewelry appeal Perfect for statement pieces How to Style Lapis Lazuli Jewelry Pair with black, white, navy, or neutral outfits Wear with gold jewelry for a cohesive look Let one lapis piece be the focal point Use statement rings or earrings for evening wear Add a pendant necklace for everyday sophistication A lapis lazuli ring or necklace can elevate nearly any wardrobe with effortless elegance. Luxury Lapis Lazuli Jewelry vs. Mass Market Jewelry Luxury lapis lazuli jewelry stands apart through craftsmanship, gemstone quality, and artistic design. Deeper, richer blue stones Premium gold settings Hand-finished details Unique one-of-a-kind designs Heirloom-quality craftsmanship Mass-produced pieces often lack the richness, balance, and sophistication found in true luxury jewelry. Why Choose Piranesi Lapis Lazuli Jewelry Italian-inspired artistry Premium gemstone selection Bold, statement-driven designs Timeless elegance Piranesi creates jewelry that blends history, color, and modern design. Shop Lapis Lazuli Jewelry Discover the beauty of lapis lazuli jewelry at Piranesi, where bold gemstone design meets timeless luxury. Known for its deep royal blue color and natural golden flecks, lapis lazuli has been treasured for centuries and remains one of the most distinctive gemstones in fine jewelry. Our collection celebrates this iconic stone through elegant rings, statement earrings, necklaces, and one-of-a-kind designs created for collectors and style lovers alike. Piranesi’s designer lapis lazuli jewelry combines rich blue gemstones with radiant gold and brilliant diamonds for pieces that feel modern, artistic, and unforgettable. Whether you are searching for a dramatic cocktail ring or refined everyday luxury, lapis lazuli offers a vibrant alternative to traditional gemstones. Explore stunning lapis lazuli rings crafted to showcase the stone’s natural character and striking color. These bold designs pair beautifully with yellow gold and make exceptional statement jewelry for day or evening wear. Our collection also includes sophisticated lapis lazuli earrings that bring rich color and elegance to any look. For those seeking a signature necklace, discover luxurious lapis lazuli necklaces designed to elevate every wardrobe. The intense blue tones of lapis lazuli create an eye-catching contrast against gold settings, making each piece both timeless and contemporary. As part of our broader gemstone collection, Piranesi also offers jewelry featuring opal, turquoise, malachite, and sapphire, but lapis lazuli jewelry remains a favorite for those drawn to bold color and refined luxury. Every design reflects exceptional craftsmanship and the artistic heritage that defines Piranesi. Browse our collection today to discover exclusive luxury lapis lazuli jewelry made to be worn, admired, and treasured for generations. FAQ SECTION What is lapis lazuli jewelry? --> Login Cart Collections Products View all products Luxury Gemstone Jewelry: Designer Gold Rings, Earrings & Necklaces Luxury gemstone jewelry represents the intersection of artistry, craftsmanship, and bold design. Unlike traditional fine jewelry that often centers around diamonds, gemstone jewelry celebrates color, individuality, and expression through vibrant stones such as turquoise, malachite, lapis lazuli, and opal. At Piranesi, luxury gemstone jewelry is redefined through sculptural gold settings, distinctive design language, and carefully selected stones. Each piece is created to stand out — offering a balance between timeless elegance and modern statement design. What Is Luxury Gemstone Jewelry? Luxury gemstone jewelry features high-quality colored stones set in precious metals, designed with a focus on artistry and uniqueness. Key elements include: Premium gemstones with rich color and character High-quality gold settings Unique, designer-driven aesthetics Attention to detail and craftsmanship These pieces are designed not just to be worn, but to be experienced. Amethyst Gemstone Jewelry by Piranesi Amethyst gemstone jewelry brings together vivid purple hues, timeless elegance, and exceptional craftsmanship. At Piranesi , our collection of luxury amethyst jewelry showcases handcrafted Italian artistry through exquisite amethyst rings, amethyst earrings, amethyst necklaces, and amethyst pendant jewelry designed in radiant 18K gold. Explore amethyst fine jewelry featuring one of the world’s most captivating purple gemstones within our curated colored gemstone jewelry collections. Amethyst gemstone jewelry has captivated collectors, royalty, and jewelry enthusiasts for centuries with its unmistakable purple brilliance and sophisticated elegance. Known as one of the most desirable purple gemstones in the world, amethyst possesses a rich depth of color that ranges from delicate lavender to intense royal violet. This natural beauty makes amethyst jewelry one of the most versatile and luxurious choices within the world of fine gemstone jewelry. At Piranesi, amethyst fine jewelry is designed to celebrate the gemstone’s vibrant personality while maintaining the refined elegance associated with Italian luxury craftsmanship. Whether featured within elegant amethyst necklaces, statement amethyst rings, or dazzling amethyst earrings, every design emphasizes exceptional artistry and timeless sophistication. Luxury amethyst jewelry pairs beautifully with diamonds, yellow gold, rose gold, and white gold, allowing designers to create extraordinary pieces that feel simultaneously classic and modern. The gemstone’s vivid purple tones create dramatic contrast against precious metals, making amethyst gold jewelry especially eye-catching for both everyday wear and special occasions. Clients seeking unique colored gemstone jewelry often gravitate toward amethyst because of its combination of beauty, rarity, and versatility. Unlike more traditional white diamond jewelry, purple gemstone jewelry introduces vibrant color and personality into a jewelry collection while still maintaining an elegant, luxurious aesthetic. Explore additional colored gemstone jewelry collections featuring exceptional handcrafted designs inspired by the world’s finest gemstones. Amethyst Earrings in 18K Gold Elevate your collection with amethyst earrings in 18k gold , where rich purple tones meet the warmth of finely crafted gold. Known for its deep, regal color, amethyst is one of the most sought-after gemstones for statement jewelry, making amethyst earrings gold an essential addition for those who appreciate both elegance and individuality. At Piranesi, each design reflects a balance of artistry and craftsmanship, creating pieces that are both timeless and distinctive. Our collection of purple gemstone earrings gold showcases a range of styles, from refined everyday pieces to bold, eye-catching designs. For those seeking movement and brilliance, explore our Pietra Drop Earrings , which highlight vibrant gemstones in an elegant drop silhouette. If you prefer a more classic and structured design, the Classic Flower Drop Earrings offer a timeless interpretation of gold amethyst drop earrings , combining intricate detailing with luxurious materials. For a modern approach, the Pasha Drop Earrings present a contemporary take on amethyst earrings in gold , blending sleek design with fine craftsmanship. Whether styled for everyday elegance or a formal occasion, gold amethyst earrings bring depth, color, and sophistication to any look. Their versatility allows them to pair beautifully with both neutral tones and bold ensembles, making them a standout choice in any jewelry collection. With each pair handcrafted in 18k gold, Piranesi’s designs ensure lasting quality while showcasing the natural beauty of amethyst and other fine gemstones. Amethyst Gold Rings: Timeless Elegance in Fine Jewelry An amethyst gold ring combines the rich beauty of purple gemstones with the timeless sophistication of handcrafted fine jewelry. Revered for centuries for its vibrant violet color and luxurious appearance, amethyst remains one of the most desirable gemstones in the world of high-end jewelry design. At Piranesi , our collection of luxury gemstone jewelry celebrates the elegance of amethyst through beautifully crafted rings set in radiant 18K gold. The striking contrast between vivid purple amethyst gemstones and warm yellow gold creates a bold yet refined aesthetic that feels both classic and contemporary. Whether designed as a dramatic cocktail ring or an elegant everyday statement piece, an amethyst gold ring offers remarkable versatility and sophistication. White gold settings introduce a sleek modern edge, while rose gold enhances the romantic warmth of the gemstone’s natural color. Luxury amethyst rings are admired not only for their beauty but also for their individuality. No two amethyst gemstones are exactly alike, making every handcrafted design uniquely captivating. Deep royal purple tones, flashes of lavender, and brilliant clarity allow amethyst jewelry to stand out within any fine jewelry collection. For collectors seeking colorful statement jewelry that maintains timeless elegance, amethyst remains an exceptional choice. At Piranesi, Italian craftsmanship and artistic design come together to create extraordinary gemstone jewelry inspired by elegance, fashion, and individuality. Our handcrafted cocktail rings showcase exceptional gemstone artistry while celebrating the luxurious beauty of colored gemstones. Designs such as the Pietra Emerald Cut Eternity Band and the Pietra Oval Eternity Band exemplify the bold elegance and refined craftsmanship that define modern luxury gemstone rings. Pair an amethyst gold ring with elegant pendant necklaces or vibrant colored gemstone jewelry collections to create a refined and sophisticated jewelry wardrobe. As colored gemstone jewelry continues to rise in popularity within luxury fashion, amethyst gold jewelry remains one of the most sought-after expressions of personal style and timeless refinement. Whether worn for everyday sophistication or formal evening occasions, an amethyst gold ring introduces bold color, artistic craftsmanship, and enduring elegance into every jewelry collection. Designer Gemstone Rings Designer gemstone rings are the cornerstone of luxury jewelry collections. They combine bold color with sculptural design, creating pieces that are both expressive and refined. Popular styles: Statement gemstone rings Cocktail rings with large stones Artistic, one-of-a-kind designs Gold rings with vibrant gemstones These rings often serve as signature pieces for the wearer. Luxury Gemstone Earrings Luxury gemstone earrings add color and sophistication to any look. From subtle studs to bold statement designs, they offer versatility and impact. Types of gemstone earrings: Drop earrings Statement earrings Stud earrings Designer, sculptural styles Gemstones bring depth and individuality to each design. 18K Gold Drop Earrings by Piranesi Elegant, expressive, and unmistakably luxurious, Piranesi’s collection of 18k gold earrings embodies the artistry of Italian fine jewelry. Designed for collectors who appreciate exceptional craftsmanship and sophisticated style, these drop earrings are handcrafted to showcase the beauty of movement, light, and rare colored gemstones. Each creation reflects the signature Piranesi approach to luxury jewelry design, blending old-world Italian artistry with contemporary glamour. Crafted in rich 18K yellow, white, and rose gold, Piranesi earrings are designed to create a luminous effect that enhances the brilliance of diamonds and vibrant gemstones. The fluid silhouette of drop earrings allows light to reflect beautifully from every angle, producing movement and radiance that naturally draws attention to the face and neckline. Whether styled for an elegant evening event, formal occasion, cocktail attire, or elevated everyday luxury, these earrings are designed to make a sophisticated statement. Piranesi’s collections are celebrated for their use of extraordinary gemstones, including sapphires, emeralds, rubies, amethysts, turquoise, lapis lazuli, mother-of-pearl, and diamonds. These precious materials are carefully selected for their color saturation, clarity, and visual depth before being expertly incorporated into handcrafted settings. Many designs combine intricate pavé diamond work with vibrant gemstone arrangements, creating dimensional pieces that shimmer beautifully under natural and evening lighting. As a leader in designer gemstone earrings , Piranesi emphasizes artisanal craftsmanship in every detail. Skilled Italian jewelers carefully hand-finish each piece to ensure exceptional polish, symmetry, comfort, and durability. From sculptural gold settings to precision stone placement, every element is designed to enhance elegance and wearability while maintaining the luxurious aesthetic associated with high-end Italian jewelry. One of the defining characteristics of luxury drop earrings is their ability to create graceful movement. Unlike static stud earrings, drop earrings sway naturally with motion, allowing gemstones and diamonds to capture and reflect light dynamically throughout the day and evening. This fluidity gives the jewelry a more dramatic and refined appearance, making 18K gold drop earrings especially desirable for evening wear, gala events, weddings, black-tie occasions, and luxury fashion styling. Piranesi’s designs also offer remarkable versatility. While these earrings make stunning statement pieces for formal occasions, they can also elevate modern daywear when paired with tailored fashion, monochromatic outfits, or minimalist luxury styling. The warmth and richness of 18K gold complements both classic and contemporary wardrobes, while colored gemstones add individuality and artistic expression. For clients seeking floral-inspired elegance, Piranesi’s diamond flower earrings combine intricate craftsmanship with romantic Italian design. These collections reinterpret floral motifs using brilliant diamonds, sculpted gold, and colorful gemstones to create timeless luxury jewelry with exceptional visual impact. The beauty of luxury drop earrings lies not only in their brilliance, but also in their craftsmanship and artistic individuality. Piranesi designs are created for collectors who value fine details, hand-finished artistry, and jewelry that feels distinctive and unforgettable. Every surface is polished to maximize reflection and luminosity, while each gemstone arrangement is engineered to enhance color contrast and visual movement. Italian luxury jewelry has long been admired for combining technical mastery with emotional beauty, and Piranesi continues this tradition through sophisticated designs that feel both timeless and modern. Whether featuring bold colored gemstones, cascading diamond details, or sculptural gold silhouettes, these earrings are designed to become heirloom-quality pieces that transcend seasonal fashion trends. As demand for colored gemstone jewelry continues to rise in the luxury market, statement earrings featuring sapphires, emeralds, rubies, and other vibrant stones have become increasingly sought after among collectors and fashion enthusiasts alike. Piranesi’s commitment to quality craftsmanship, refined Italian design, and exceptional gemstone sourcing positions its 18K gold drop earrings among the most distinctive luxury jewelry creations available today. Gemstone Necklaces & Pendants Gemstone necklaces are elegant and expressive, often serving as the focal point of a jewelry look. Popular styles: Pendant necklaces Statement necklaces Beaded gemstone necklaces Gold chain necklaces with gemstones These pieces offer a balance of boldness and refinement. The Beauty of Colored Gemstones Colored gemstones are at the heart of luxury jewelry design. Featured gemstones: Turquoise – vibrant, energetic blue Malachite – rich, patterned green Lapis lazuli – deep, timeless blue Opal – luminous, ever-changing color Each gemstone offers a unique visual experience. Luxury Opal Gemstone Jewelry by Piranesi Among the most captivating pieces in fine jewelry, opal gemstone jewelry is prized for its extraordinary play-of-color, luminous depth, and one-of-a-kind beauty. At Piranesi , our luxury gemstone creations celebrate the natural brilliance of opals through bold rings, elegant pendants, statement earrings, and handcrafted designs set in gold. From pink opals to fiery white opals, each gemstone offers a distinctive character that makes opal jewelry highly sought after by collectors and style-conscious women. Whether you are searching for an opal statement ring, gold opal pendant, or refined gemstone earrings, opals bring artistry and individuality to every collection. Our designers pair exceptional opals with diamonds, sapphires, and precious metals to create heirloom-quality luxury jewelry with modern presence. Explore our curated collection of opal jewelry for pieces that combine timeless craftsmanship with unforgettable color. Statement Jewelry in Luxury Collections Statement jewelry plays a central role in gemstone collections. Why statement pieces matter: Create a strong visual impact Highlight gemstone color and size Allow for artistic expression Define personal style Luxury gemstone jewelry is often designed to stand out rather than blend in. Craftsmanship Behind Luxury Jewelry Luxury jewelry is defined by the quality of its craftsmanship. Key aspects: Precision in stone setting Attention to design details High-quality materials Skilled artisanship This craftsmanship ensures each piece is both beautiful and durable. Why Gold Is Essential in Gemstone Jewelry Gold is the preferred metal for luxury gemstone jewelry. Benefits: Enhances gemstone color Provides durability Adds warmth and richness Complements a wide range of designs Gold settings are a hallmark of high-end jewelry. How to Choose Luxury Gemstone Jewelry Consider: Gemstone color and type Design and scale Occasion Personal style Choosing the right piece ensures it becomes a lasting part of your collection. How to Style Luxury Gemstone Jewelry Styling tips: Let one piece be the focal point Pair with neutral tones Combine with gold accessories Avoid over-layering bold pieces Luxury gemstone jewelry is most effective when styled with intention. Explore Luxury Gemstone Jewelry at Piranesi Piranesi offers a curated selection of bold, artistic gemstone jewelry. Explore: Statement gemstone rings Designer gemstone earrings Luxury gemstone necklaces Unique, handcrafted designs Each piece reflects a commitment to artistry and individuality. Why Choose Piranesi Italian-inspired design Premium gemstone selection Bold, statement-driven pieces Exceptional craftsmanship Piranesi creates jewelry that stands apart — blending luxury with artistic expression. FAQ SECTION What is luxury gemstone jewelry? It refers to high-end jewelry featuring colored gemstones set in precious metals like gold. Is gemstone jewelry considered fine jewelry? Yes, especially when made with high-quality materials and craftsmanship. What gemstones are used in luxury jewelry? Common examples include turquoise, malachite, lapis lazuli, and opal. Why choose gemstone jewelry over diamonds? Gemstone jewelry offers more color, individuality, and artistic expression. What are 18k gold drop earrings? 18K gold drop earrings are luxury earrings crafted from gold that contains 75% pure gold. Unlike stud earrings, drop earrings extend below the earlobe and are designed to create elegant movement and enhanced light reflection. Are 18k gold earrings better than 14k? 18K gold earrings contain a higher percentage of pure gold than 14K gold, giving them a richer color and more luxurious appearance. They are especially popular in fine jewelry and high-end Italian craftsmanship. How do you style gold drop earrings? Gold drop earrings can be styled with eveningwear, cocktail dresses, tailored fashion, or elevated everyday outfits. Their elegant movement and brilliance make them ideal statement accessories for formal and luxury styling. Are gemstone drop earrings in style? Yes. Colored gemstone drop earrings remain highly fashionable in luxury jewelry due to their vibrant colors, versatility, and ability to create dramatic visual impact while showcasing individuality and craftsmanship. --> Login Cart Collections Products View all products Turquoise Jewelry in Gold: Luxury Rings, Earrings & Necklaces Turquoise jewelry has captivated collectors and designers for centuries, celebrated for its vibrant blue hues and unmistakable character. In luxury jewelry, turquoise stands apart as a gemstone that blends bold color with timeless elegance, making it a cornerstone of statement design. At Piranesi, turquoise jewelry is elevated through rich gold settings, sculptural forms, and Italian-inspired artistry. From bold turquoise rings to refined earrings and striking necklaces, each piece is designed to showcase the natural beauty of this iconic gemstone. What Makes Turquoise Jewelry So Unique? Turquoise is one of the oldest gemstones used in jewelry, prized for its vivid color and organic veining. No two stones are identical, giving each piece a one-of-a-kind appearance. Key qualities of turquoise: Distinctive blue and green tones Natural veining patterns (matrix) Smooth, polished surfaces ideal for bold designs Strong visual contrast when set in gold Unlike transparent gemstones, turquoise offers a rich, opaque color that immediately draws the eye — making it ideal for statement jewelry. Turquoise Rings: Bold Statement Pieces Turquoise rings are among the most sought-after pieces in luxury gemstone jewelry. Their bold color and substantial presence make them the centerpiece of any collection. Popular turquoise ring styles: Turquoise statement rings – large stones designed to stand out Turquoise cocktail rings – bold, elegant, and perfect for evening wear Gold turquoise rings – warm gold enhances the gemstone’s color Designer turquoise rings – artistic, one-of-a-kind creations A turquoise ring is often the defining element of an outfit, offering both color and sophistication. Turquoise Butterfly Ring Designs in Fine Jewelry Among the most distinctive styles in our collection, the turquoise butterfly ring blends vivid gemstone color with elegant symbolic design. Piranesi reimagines the butterfly motif through refined craftsmanship, combining luminous turquoise with sculptural gold detailing for a bold statement ring that feels both feminine and timeless. Turquoise Earrings: Effortless Elegance Turquoise earrings provide a versatile way to incorporate color into your look. Whether subtle or bold, they bring vibrancy and refinement. Types of turquoise earrings: Drop earrings with turquoise accents Turquoise stud earrings in gold Beaded turquoise earrings Statement turquoise earrings These pieces work beautifully for both everyday wear and special occasions. Turquoise Necklaces & Pendants A turquoise necklace adds depth and color to any outfit. Whether worn alone or layered, it creates a striking focal point. Popular styles: Turquoise pendant necklaces Statement turquoise necklaces Beaded turquoise strands Gold chain necklaces with turquoise accents A turquoise pendant in gold offers a perfect balance of boldness and elegance. Why Turquoise and Gold Are the Perfect Combination The pairing of turquoise and gold is one of the most iconic in jewelry design. Why it works: Gold enhances turquoise’s vivid color Warm and cool tones create visual contrast The combination feels both classic and contemporary This contrast is what gives turquoise jewelry its signature luxurious appeal. Turquoise Jewelry as Statement Jewelry Turquoise is inherently bold, making it ideal for statement jewelry pieces. Why turquoise stands out: Vibrant color draws immediate attention Larger stones amplify visual impact Works across rings, earrings, and necklaces For those seeking statement jewelry that feels both natural and refined, turquoise is a top choice. How to Style Turquoise Jewelry Styling turquoise jewelry is about letting its color shine. Styling tips: Pair with neutral tones (white, black, beige) Combine with gold accessories for cohesion Let one turquoise piece be the focal point Mix with other gemstones carefully A turquoise ring or necklace can instantly elevate even the simplest outfit. The Meaning and Appeal of Turquoise Beyond its beauty, turquoise has long been associated with protection, strength, and tranquility. While modern luxury focuses on design and craftsmanship, this historical significance adds depth and intrigue to the gemstone. Luxury Turquoise Jewelry vs. Mass Market Pieces Not all turquoise jewelry is created equal. Luxury turquoise jewelry offers: Higher-quality gemstones with richer color Expert craftsmanship and finishing Unique, artistic designs Long-lasting durability Mass-produced pieces often lack the depth of color and design detail found in luxury collections. Explore Turquoise Jewelry at Piranesi Piranesi’s turquoise jewelry reflects a commitment to bold design, fine materials, and artistic expression. Explore pieces including: Turquoise statement rings Gold turquoise earrings Turquoise pendant necklaces Designer gemstone creations Each piece is crafted to highlight the beauty of turquoise in a distinctive and luxurious way. Why Choose Piranesi Turquoise Jewelry Italian-inspired craftsmanship High-quality turquoise gemstones Unique, statement-driven designs Timeless yet modern aesthetic Piranesi creates turquoise jewelry that stands out — combining color, artistry, and luxury. FAQ SECTION Is turquoise jewelry considered luxury jewelry? Yes, when crafted with high-quality stones and gold settings, turquoise jewelry is a staple in luxury collections. What outfits go best with turquoise jewelry? Neutral tones allow turquoise to stand out, but it can also complement bold, colorful styles. Are turquoise rings good for everyday wear? Yes, especially when set in durable gold designs. Why is turquoise paired with gold? Gold enhances the gemstone’s color and creates a rich, high-contrast look. showcase of one-of-a-kind masterpieces that are true collector's items. Our artisans have meticulously curated rare and precious stones, pairing them with simple, understated designs that allow the stones to take center stage. Each piece is a celebration of the stone's inherent beauty, showcasing its unique qualities and allure to be passed down from generation to generation. Vendome Collection Inspired by the iconic Place Vendôme in Paris, the Vendome Collection is a tribute to elegance and timeless style. Each piece in this collection features pear-shaped designs that echo the grandeur of this prestigious location. Meticulously crafted, the Vendome Collection brings an air of sophistication to any formal occasion. Shop Now Portrait Baguette diamonds take center stage in the Portrait Collection, elegantly framing the most important stones at the heart of each piece. With a design that mirrors the sophistication of a timeless portrait, these jewels capture the essence of grace and individuality. Discover More Classic Collection The Classic Collection has withstood the test of time and is regarded a staple in every collector's gem box. Clean and classic lines with emphasis on the gem stones, keep the design linear and simplistic, yet with an edge. Shop Now Gemma Sleek, clean, and modern design with precious gems designed for a lifestyle of the modern woman. The Gemma Collection embodies a bold sophistication for a casual lifestyle. Discover More Riviera The Riviera Collection, handcrafted by our talented Italian artisans, is where timeless design meets the everlasting beauty of diamonds. Discover More Masterpieces The Masterpiece Collection epitomizes our rarest, most precious and sought after one-of-a kind gemstones. Understated designs highlight the magnificence and pureness of the collector stones. Built around the uniqueness of each stone, the designs featured in the masterpiece collection highlight the beauty of each stone. Discover More Elizabeth Taylor Piranesi joined forces with the legendary Elizabeth Taylor to create a jewelry collection of unparalleled opulence. Their collaboration was a labor of love, as they worked closely together to transform her vivid jewelry dreams into exquisite reality. Elizabeth's passion for glamour and Piranesi's artistic brilliance converged in each meticulously designed piece. The result was a collection that not only captured her extraordinary beauty but also her indomitable spirit. Each jewel in this collection carries with it the essence of Hollywood's golden era, a testament to a unique collaboration that continues to dazzle and inspire, embodying the timeless allure of both Elizabeth Taylor and Piranesi. The house has archived a few of her remaining jewels and designs, making them only available to the most esteemed Piranesi collectors worldwide. Collections Products View all products 18K Gold Drop Earrings Discover the elegance of 18k gold drop earrings crafted with exceptional attention to detail by Piranesi. Designed for movement, brilliance, and timeless luxury, our collection features diamond drop earrings , gemstone drop earrings , and refined silhouettes in 18K yellow, white, and rose gold . Whether you're searching for everyday sophistication or statement jewelry, our designer drop earrings offer graceful movement, rich color, and heirloom quality. Shop 18K Gold Drop Earrings in Yellow, White & Rose Gold Explore our curated collection of luxury drop earrings, each designed to highlight the natural beauty of fine gemstones and 18k gold craftsmanship: Pietra Drop Earrings – Elegant gemstone drop earrings featuring vibrant stones set in 18k gold. Classic Flower Drop Earrings – Iconic diamond drop earrings inspired by floral design and timeless beauty. Pasha Drop Earrings – Contemporary 18k gold drop earrings with a refined, modern silhouette. Each pair is meticulously handcrafted to ensure exceptional quality, brilliance, and lasting wear. Designer 18K Gold Drop Earrings with Diamonds & Gemstones Piranesi’s designer 18k gold drop earrings combine fine Italian craftsmanship with artistic expression. From radiant diamonds to richly colored gemstones like sapphires, turquoise, and citrine, each piece is designed to capture light and movement. Our collection includes: Diamond drop earrings for timeless sophistication Gemstone drop earrings for bold, colorful statements Gold drop earrings in classic and contemporary styles Luxury 18K Gold Drop Earrings for Every Occasion Whether you're dressing for a formal event or elevating everyday wear, 18k gold drop earrings offer unmatched versatility. Their elongated design enhances the neckline while adding movement and elegance. Perfect for: Evening events and formal occasions Luxury gifting Everyday elevated style Why Choose 18K Gold Drop Earrings? 18k gold offers the perfect balance of purity, durability, and richness of color. Compared to lower karat gold, it delivers a more luxurious appearance while maintaining strength for everyday wear. 75% pure gold for superior richness Long-lasting durability Ideal for fine jewelry and heirloom pieces How to Choose the Best 18K Gold Drop Earrings When selecting the perfect pair of 18k gold drop earrings , consider the following: Length: Short drops for subtle elegance, longer styles for statement impact Gemstones: Diamonds for timeless beauty, colored stones for personality Gold Tone: Yellow gold for warmth, white gold for modern appeal, rose gold for softness Popular Styles of 18K Gold Drop Earrings Piranesi offers a wide range of styles to suit every aesthetic: Floral-inspired drop earrings Geometric and modern silhouettes Statement gemstone drop earrings Minimalist gold drop earrings Shop Luxury 18K Gold Drop Earrings Online At Piranesi, every pair of 18k gold drop earrings is handcrafted using the finest materials and traditional techniques. Our commitment to quality ensures that each piece is not only beautiful but designed to last for generations. Browse our collection to find the perfect pair that reflects your personal style, whether you're searching for diamond drop earrings , gold statement earrings , or luxury gemstone jewelry . FAQs About 18K Gold Drop Earrings What are 18k gold drop earrings? 18k gold drop earrings are earrings made from 75% pure gold that hang below the earlobe, offering elegance and movement. Are 18k gold earrings worth it? Yes, 18k gold provides a luxurious appearance with strong durability, making it ideal for fine jewelry. What length drop earrings are best? The ideal length depends on your style—shorter drops are subtle, while longer designs create a more dramatic look. Are gemstone drop earrings in style? Yes, gemstone drop earrings are highly sought after for their color, individuality, and statement appeal. Rights (Australia & New Zealand) If you are located in Australia or New Zealand, you may have rights regarding your personal information under the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020. Please use the options below to exercise your rights. Access or download my data You can request access to the personal information we hold about you, including account details and order history. Where reasonable and practicable, we will provide access in the format you request. Request Data Report Enter your email to confirm your identity Response time: New Zealand: We will respond as soon as reasonably practicable and generally within 20 working days (unless extended as permitted by law). Australia: We will respond within a reasonable period. Correct my information If you believe the personal information we hold about you is inaccurate, out of date, incomplete, or misleading, you can request a correction. Edit Personal Info Enter your email to confirm your identity Delete my data / Close my account You may request deletion of your account and personal information. We will process this request where possible, subject to legal and operational requirements. Request Deletion Enter your email to confirm your identity Important: We may retain certain information where required by law (for example, tax or transaction records) or for fraud prevention. In Australia, we are also required to take reasonable steps to destroy or de-identify personal information once it is no longer needed, subject to exceptions. Your privacy choices Manage Your Privacy Choices Depending on your location, you may have the right to opt out of the sale of your personal info, withdraw consent for tracking, or customize your cookie preferences. Update Privacy Settings Direct marketing & preferences You can request that we stop using your personal information for direct marketing. You can unsubscribe at any time using the "Unsubscribe" link in our emails. You can also contact us at nadine@piranesi.com to opt out. Contact information For questions about your privacy rights or to lodge a complaint, please contact: Email: nadine@piranesi.com Address: 592 5th Avenue, Fifth Floor, 10036 New York New York, United States Complaints If you believe your privacy rights have been violated, you can lodge a complaint with your national authority: Australia: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) New Zealand: Office of the Privacy Commissioner (OPC) " class="image-with-text__image" style=" object-fit:cover;object-position:50.0% 50.0%; " > From the vibrant interplay of hues in multicolored opals to the delicate blush of pink varieties, each stone offers its own distinct allure, bringing a refined touch of color and sophistication to any jewelry collection. availability of the piece. Delivery time can vary. Most product ships for next day delivery, while other products will take 7-14 days for delivery. For exact details on availability of each product please call (212)332-7373 or email piranesi@piranesi.com . Returns All returns must be sent within 14 days upon receipt. Please email returns@piranesi.com to request a return label. Returned items must be in perfect/sellable condition. In order for returns to be accepted, all original tags must remain attached. In the event that the package was damaged in transit, you must notify Piranesi within 24 hours upon receipt. For any further questions, please email: shop@piranesi.com Special Orders In the event that your desired piece is unavailable in your size/color preference, please email shop@piranesi.com to place a special order. All special orders must be pre-paid for in full in advance. Please allow 6-8 weeks for delivery. In some cases, items may be delivered sooner but there is no guarantee. Disclaimer Important Notice Regarding Stones Please be reminded that many color gemstones have historically been treated to enhance their appearance. These enhancements contribute to their beauty and/or durability. A variety of methods including heat, irradiation, filling and oiling may be used. Certain enhancement methods, such as heating, are commonly used to improve both color and/or transparency, particularly in rubies and sapphires. Other methods such as oiling enhance the clarity of Emeralds. These methods have been generally accepted by the international jewelry trade. Although, heat enhancement of color is widely believed to be permanent, it may have some impact on the durability of the gemstone and special care of the stone may be required over time. For example, gemstones that have been oiled may require re-oiling after a period of years to retain their maximum appearance. It is not feasible for PIRANESI to obtain a gemological report for each gemstone offered by PIRANESI. Prospective buyers should be aware that all gemstones may have been enhanced by some method. For further details, prospective buyers in the United States are referred to the information chart prepared by the Gemstones Standards Commission or to the American Gem Trade Associations Gemstone Enhancement manual, or contact AGTA at (214) 742-4367. Prospective buyers may request laboratory reports for most un-certified items and this service is subject to prepayment by the requesting party. Most reports from gemological laboratories in the USA will disclose any heat enhancement or treatment. European gemological laboratory reports will disclose heat enhancement only if specifically requested but will confirm when no heat enhancement or treatment has been made. New forms of treatment and new scientific methods to discern them are constantly being developed. Consequently, there may be a lack of consensus among laboratories as to whether gemstones have been treated, the extent of treatment or the permanence of treatment. All diamond grading is based upon the Gemological Institute of America (G.I.A.) standards and guidelines to determine approximate color range and approximate clarity range. All grades and measurements of stones and mountings should be considered approximate unless otherwise stated by a certificate. The foregoing is provided by PIRANESI for informational and descriptive purposes only. PIRANESI hereby expressly disclaims any and all liability, damages, actual or consequential, of any nature whatsoever, based upon customer’s use of or reliance upon the foregoing. If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Use the options below to exercise your rights regarding the personal data we hold about you. How we process your request When you submit a request through this page, our compliance provider (Consentmo) processes your email address and technical information (such as IP address) only to verify and fulfill your request, prevent misuse, and keep records of compliance. For more details, see Consentmo's Data Processing Policy . Access or download my data You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, including account details and order history. You may request your data in a portable format (CSV or PDF). Request my data Enter your email to confirm your identity Response time: We respond within one month. If your request is complex, we may extend this period as permitted by law and will inform you. Correct my information If you believe your personal data is inaccurate or incomplete (for example, a wrong shipping address or misspelled name), you can update it here. Correct my information Enter your email to confirm your identity Delete my data You can request the deletion of your personal data associated with this store (also known as the "Right to be Forgotten"). Request deletion Enter your email to confirm your identity Important: Some information may be retained where required by law or for legitimate purposes (for example, tax, fraud prevention, and security). Manage Privacy Preferences You can customize your experience by choosing exactly which types of cookies and technologies you allow us to use (e.g., enabling analytics but disabling marketing). You can update these specific settings at any time. Update Cookie Settings Withdraw Consent You have the right to withdraw your Shopify marketing consent for tracking technologies at any time. This will apply to your future use of our store and will stop data collection for optional purposes. Enter your email to identify your request Restrict or object to processing You may request that we restrict the processing of your personal data or object to certain processing activities (such as direct marketing or processing based on legitimate interests). To exercise these rights, please contact us at: 📧 nadine@piranesi.com Contact information For questions about your privacy rights or this page, contact: Email: nadine@piranesi.com Address: 592 5th Avenue, Fifth Floor, 10036 New York New York, United States Lodge a complaint If you believe we have not adequately addressed your concerns, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your national Data Protection Authority (DPA). Carefully handcrafted and designed, the richness of gold combined with the brilliance of diamonds creates a harmonious symphony that elevates any collection. Shop Now Pietra Collection The Pietra Collection , a testament to the timeless allure of water-colored semiprecious stones in a sleek and modern design, makes a statement that's both refined and radiant. A symphony of natural beauty and contemporary style, this collection adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to your lifestyle. Each piece effortlessly melds classic with a modern aesthetic, creating a statement that stands out for its refined subtlety. Each piece is a testament to exquisite craftsmanship, drawing from the rich history and artistic heritage of Italy. The Capri Collection , inspired by the vivid colors of this Italian paradise, features the enchanting hues from turquoise to the iridescence of mother-of-pearl and the warmth of pink opal with the magic of this Mediterranean gem. This whimsical and artful design offers a journey into nature's wonders where each piece is a wearable work of art, celebrating the artistry of the natural world.
